news.title: Renewed U.S.-Iran tensions in the Strait of Hormuz
news.summary: Two oil tankers, one Saudi-owned and one South Korean-owned, were hit overnight in the Strait of Hormuz, a fresh escalation that sent oil higher and equity futures broadly lower into Tuesday's session.

news.title: Stocks close lower on the Hormuz escalation
news.summary: The Dow, Nasdaq, and S&P 500 all finished Tuesday's session lower as renewed Strait of Hormuz tanker strikes weighed on broad risk appetite; crude surged on the shipping-route risk.

news.title: Energy names outperforming, chipmakers lead the decline
news.summary: Names tied to oil and gas production traded higher as crude climbed on the Hormuz risk, while chip and broader tech names took the brunt of the day's intraday selloff.

news.title: Bitcoin and Ether soften, proxy basket underperforms spot
news.summary: BTC and ETH both traded lower on the session, with the broader crypto-proxy equity basket falling further than spot -- a real divergence that persisted most of the day before narrowing somewhat into the afternoon.

news.title: Rate-cut odds jump ahead of the Sept 15-16 FOMC meeting
news.summary: Futures-implied odds of a 25bp cut at the September Fed meeting rose meaningfully during the session, alongside firm Treasury yields, as markets continued digesting last week's Jackson Hole remarks.

news.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI printed in line
news.summary: The week's first scheduled economic release landed broadly in line with recent readings, with equities firming rather than selling off further in its immediate aftermath.
